plugins.description: Seven skills that make animations for reels with no footage: a 3D cartoon explainer, a stick-figure explainer, a 2D pixel-world explainer, minimal black-and-white line art, a 3D map route, a 3D exploded view that turns around the object, and a minimal line graph.
